      public void initialize(URL url, ResourceBundle resourceBundle)

    • runReport1

      public void runReport1(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method is called when the Run button on the first report is clicked. It counts the number of customer appointments by type and month, and displays in a textfield.

    • runReport2

      public void runReport2(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method is called when the Run button on the second report is clicked. It displays a schedule of appointments by contact.

    • runReport3

      public void runReport3(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method is called when the Run button on the third report is clicked. It displays the total number of appointments in the same location.

    • onCancel

      public void onCancel(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
